name: pick_and_place
definition: Pick up one or more objects and place them at a specified destination without changing their state.

name: clean_and_place
definition: Wash or rinse an object in a sink; place it at a specified destination when one is given.

name: heat_and_place
definition: Heat, warm, or cook an object in a microwave; place it at a specified destination when one is given.

name: chill_and_place
definition: Chill or cool an object in a refrigerator; place it at a specified destination when one is given.

name: fill_and_place
definition: Fill an object with water from a sink or faucet; place it at a specified destination when one is given.

name: lamp_inspection
definition: Turn on a lamp and, when a task specifies an object, pick it up or hold it in the lamp light to inspect or view it, or carry/hold it while turning the lamp on.
